policy.source: trusted owner supplies explicit private ControlOwnerPolicy; provisioning authentication is outside this API; no page, model, peer JSON or environment approval
policy.kernel: actual original SO_PEERCRED, exact configured UID and GID and optional exact positive PID; channel still requires actual SCM_CREDENTIALS from the same peer
policy.runtime: fixed default /proc live executable bytes, uniform IDs, exact configured cgroup/unit, original start time and pidfd
policy.executable_pin: canonical 64 lowercase hexadecimal policy digest compared to actual live /proc executable SHA256; never substitutes for that measurement
policy.refresh: original pidfd and entire original live snapshot rechecked before and after control setup, send and receive; no replacement process, static source or configurable attestor

budgets.accepted: fixed sender entry Instant before capture_before and any control attestation; conservative original native wire deadline and returned opaque Instant never renew that ceiling
budgets.receiver_control_wait: separate fixed receiver entry Instant before attestation; all remaining Duration calls checked before and after against this same Instant
budgets.cancellation: exclusive mutable owner cancel drops original local channel/custody; cannot concurrently interrupt a call already borrowing it mutably

ownership.send_success: one native packet enqueue only; not receiver admission or action/durable receipt
ownership.failure: permanent local retirement; received custody drops if identity or deadline postcheck fails; no retry or repair
ownership.fork: creator PID checked before operations and mutation; Drop closes child descriptor copies only; no shutdown, copied mutex or parent process kill
ownership.returned: existing ReceivedAcceptedStream with its original socket and immutable deadline, not control-owner effect authority
